proof_steps: 1. Marginal distribution p_k ~ Beta(alpha_k, S - alpha_k)
3. Setting z = alpha_k / S in (0, 1), numerator is S^2 z(1 - z)
4. Quadratic z(1 - z) achieves global maximum 1/4 at z = 1/2
6. Since S >= K and K >= 2, S + 1 > K => Var(p_k) < 1/(4K)
7. Taking S -> infty yields lim Var(p_k) = 0

dirichlet_covariance.equation: Cov(p_i, p_j) = - alpha_i alpha_j / [S^2(S + 1)] < 0 (for all i != j)

modified_laplacian_blur.equation: E_lap(I) = 1/|Omega| sum |nabla^2 I|, B(I) = 1 - sigma(gamma_1 E_lap + gamma_2 E_fft - tau_blur)
